title: Adoption leave: whether to raise it from 12 to 16 weeks
asked: Mr Foo Cexiang asked whether the Ministry will consider increasing adoption leave from 12 weeks to 16 weeks to align it with maternity leave, and if not, what policy considerations militate against such an enhancement.
response: Ms Indranee Rajah said biological mothers are entitled to 16 weeks of maternity leave while adoptive mothers are entitled to 12 weeks of adoption leave. The month-long difference is because biological mothers require more time to recuperate physically from childbirth. Adoptive parents receive the same parental and childcare leave benefits as biological parents, including the new 10-week Shared Parental Leave scheme introduced last year. She said the Ministry will look at need when considering leave duration and is not closed to fresh ideas, with the key consideration being what is needed and required.
